policy: Read all 100 complete returned raw-completion texts against the full fixed prompt and expected result; no chat hidden-final extraction or regex grading was applied.

strict_pass requires a correct, unambiguous answer and all explicitly requested substantive calculation, explanation, verification, comparison and other components. A claimed check without an actual verification is insufficient.

core_answer_correct records the main requested result or scientific conclusion separately from a missing or faulty explanation/check. An isolated correct intermediate or option-list occurrence is not an answer. Unresolved incompatible core values fail core correctness.

A correct numerical value with correct working can pass without a unique option letter, flagged missing_option_letter. An explicitly wrong option letter fails strict_pass even when the numerical value is right.
Self-corrections are accepted only when the final resolution is clear. Contradictory explanatory claims and incorrect extra solved examples fail strict_pass.

Word-count and one-sentence formatting deviations do not determine substantive strict_pass. Salient formatting issues are flagged, without claiming an exhaustive formatting audit. Repetition or a token-limit finish alone does not fail an already complete, correct answer.
Scores are provisional manual assistant judgments for this raw scalar completion treatment, not official judging results, chat quality, ARC accuracy, or an ADTC composite score.

original_option_parser.meaning: Saved historical option-parser marks, preserved only as diagnostic; not the manual score.

review_status: all 100 responses manually reviewed; all five strict passes and the S47 core-only boundary independently cross-reviewed

independent_review.result: The independent reviewer confirmed all five strict passes. S31 was changed from strict-fail to strict-pass because the explicit bacteria/virus distinction resolves the ambiguous not-both wording. S47 remains core-correct but strict-fail for wrong explanation and missing vapour-pressure condition.
independent_review.limitation: The second reviewer did not independently regrade all 100 responses.
